Mouth tip averages left/right upper_jaw_a and lower_jaw bone positions at source t=3.5, converted to head-local coordinates. Forward follows head to center_nose. At 60 Hz over authored emission t=2.60-3.85, this native muzzle axis points 27.28-40.25 degrees above the world horizontal; the head remains upright. Jaw opening has a roughly 31.04 degree plateau and >=80% window 2.2167-4.3833. The mouth socket is an approximation because secondary jaw movement continues. Preserve the source recovery from end=3.85 to recoveryEnd=5.875; recoverAt=5.55 is only a legacy blend-ready marker (~2.93% height-normalized joint RMS difference from happy start), not the full native end. All effect events are authored recommendations.
